events.summary: Promoted to Wojek, Ossett becomes a Boros counterintelligence agent.
events.quote: After she was promoted to Wojek , Ossett Weslyn found herself at the forefront of Boros counterintelligence efforts.

events.summary: Ossett goes to the Gruul encampment on the outskirts of the Tenth District on her first assignment.
events.quote: Her first assignment as a Wojek counterintelligence agent took her to the outskirts of the Tenth District

events.summary: Brazer reveals a traitor within the Boros Legion.
events.quote: Brazer revealed the presence of a traitor within the Boros Legion

events.summary: Ossett decides to release the prisoner Baas Solvar Radley in exchange for more intelligence.
events.quote: She decided in the end to go through with the release of the prisoner

events.summary: Ossett finds Brazer murdered and is suspected by the Sunhome Guard of the poisonings.
events.quote: Ossett faced a pivotal moment when she discovered that Brazer had been murdered.

events.summary: Ossett uncovers the conspiracy and confronts her boss Embrel Skormak as the true orchestrator.
events.quote: her boss Embrel Skormak, who sought power through deceit and murder

events.summary: Ossett proves her innocence and earns the trust of the angel Aresaan.
events.quote: Ossett proved her innocence and exposed the real culprits

relations.quote: Ossett Weslyn is a Wojek minotaur , part of the Boros Legion on the plane of Ravnica .
